name: @brandbastion-mktg/platform-ui
description: The shared top bar every application in the suite carries: one stylesheet, no dependencies, no build step.
//exports: Only the stylesheet is reachable, on purpose: the closed list in the README says one file, and a package that can be reached into is a package that grows. An application resolves the real path with createRequire(import.meta.url).resolve('@brandbastion-mktg/platform-ui/header.css') and serves it from there, so there is never a second copy of it on disk.
